en.title: Your Employer Has Not Paid Your Salary
en.directAnswer: Keep proof of employment, attendance, agreed salary and earlier payments. Ask the employer or HR in writing for the unpaid amount and a payment date. If the issue is not resolved, the correct labour authority or court route depends on whether the Labour Act applies to you and the type of claim.

en.lawMeaning: Worker classification matters. Do not promise that every salaried office employee has the same Labour Act remedy. This page gives a general route. A person’s exact rights can change because of facts, documents, deadlines, legal status, court orders or later amendments.
steps: Use the correct statutory claim route if unpaid.
evidence: Appointment letter; attendance; payslips; bank records; HR messages; resignation/termination record.
en.simpleExample: A worker says three months are unpaid. A clean table showing month, agreed salary, paid amount and balance is stronger than a vague complaint.
